name: Murder Misery
source:
You're one of the lucky winners able to take part in a murder mystery game! Find out who the culprit is in time and you'll get a prize money that could settle you for life. And you can even cosplay as your favorite character.

How exciting!

If only your partner wasn't a useless, chronically online dumbass coupled with the fact that a second REAL murder happens but everybody believes it to be part of the game...
translation:
你是能够参加谋杀之谜游戏的幸运获奖者之一！及时找出罪魁祸首，你将获得一笔可以让你终生安定的奖金。你甚至可以扮演你最喜欢的角色。

多么令人兴奋啊！

如果你的伴侣不是一个无用的、长期上网的傻瓜，再加上第二起真正的谋杀案发生了，但每个人都相信这是游戏的一部分……
